features.quote: build it to map the stability curve, not just to maximize breakage, or you'll have a number that goes up without knowing what it means
features.justification_quote: A battery tuned only to 'break it as hard as possible' gives you a binary signal that doesn't tell you what to fix.

features.quote: The false-feedback arm has an ethical/UX edge: deliberately lying to the model via the oracle is fine for red-teaming, but make sure findings get interpreted correctly
features.justification_quote: deliberately lying to the model via the oracle is fine for red-teaming
